hook_text: It snowed. I almost just filmed it

song.title: First Snow
song.style: English, cosy soul shuffle with sleigh bells, warm electric piano, brushed drums, upright bass and doo-wop backing vocals, warm friendly male lead vocal, gentle and happy, 116 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Woke up to a quiet town
Something soft was coming down
Nearly filmed it for the feed
Then I thought, that's not what I need

[Chorus]
First snow, first snow, catch a flake
Roll a ball for a snowman's sake
First snow, first snow, cheeks all red
My phone is hibernating instead

[Verse]
Carrot nose and button eyes
Grandma's scarf, a perfect size
Snowball hit me with a splat
The baker laughed and I threw one back

[Chorus]
First snow, first snow, catch a flake
Whole street out for a snowman's sake
First snow, first snow, home for tea
Winter came and it found me

shots.prompt: Snowflakes drift down over the rooftops of a sleeping town of crooked clay houses at dawn. The camera cranes down slowly from the sky to one window. Soft blue dawn, warm lit windows.
{moss} throws open the curtains of a window and gasps, snow light on his face. The camera crash zooms in from outside the window. Soft white snow light.
shots.frame: He stands at a window between open curtains, seen from outside through the glass, his mouth open in amazement, snowflakes falling in front of the glass. Medium shot. Soft white snow light.

shots.prompt: Big soft snowflakes fall onto a garden with a white fence, everything covered in fresh snow. The camera pushes through a window out into the garden. Soft white snow light.
A single snowflake lands on the tip of a round clay nose and melts. Extreme close-up, the camera pushes in. Soft white light.
{moss} holds a phone up to a window to film the falling snow, tongue out, framing the shot. The camera orbits around him. Soft white snow light.
shots.frame: He stands at a window holding a phone up in both hands toward the snowy garden outside, tongue out in concentration. Medium shot. Soft white snow light.

shots.prompt: {moss} lowers the phone, looks at it, looks out at the snow, and shakes his head with a smile. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Soft white snow light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, cheerful, tugging his green beanie down over his ears, snow falling in the window behind him. The camera pushes in. Soft white snow light.
{moss} bursts out of his front door into deep snow and sinks up to his knees. The camera crash zooms in low. Bright snow light.
shots.frame: He stands in his open front doorway looking out at a garden deep in fresh snow, arms wide, delighted. Full body. Bright snow light.

shots.prompt: {moss} stands in falling snow with his tongue out, catching a snowflake on it, eyes crossed. The camera pushes in fast. Bright snow light.
{moss_back} makes the first footprints across a perfect white garden, each step sinking deep. The camera cranes up behind him. Bright snow light.
{moss} pushes a growing snowball across a white garden, leaving a green stripe of grass behind it. The camera tracks beside him. Bright snow light.
A huge snowball rolls past, picking up leaves and one green mitten. Low angle, the camera whip-pans with it. Bright snow light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, cheeks bright red, snowflakes on his mustache and beanie, snow falling all around him. The camera pushes in fast. Bright snow light.
{moss} lifts a second snowball on top of the first, stretching up on tiptoe and wobbling. The camera orbits around him. Bright snow light.

A black smartphone stands upright, face to the door, in a quilted moss-green brick stuck to a cream fridge door, a round sun-yellow badge with a closed eye on its front, a small shopping list held by a yellow magnet beside it. Soft leaf shadows sway slowly across the fridge door. Warm morning light. The camera pushes in slowly.
Snow piles up on the sill of a frosty kitchen window with a warm cosy kitchen behind it. The camera pulls back from the window into the snowy garden. Bright snow light.
{moss} pushes a big orange carrot into the face of a round snowman that already has two black button eyes. The camera pushes in on the snowman's face. Bright snow light.
A round snowman with a carrot nose and button eyes seems to smile as snow settles on his head. Close-up, the camera orbits him. Bright snow light.

A grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses wraps a long striped scarf around the neck of a round snowman while {moss} holds the other end. The camera whip-pans along the scarf. Bright snow light.
shots.frame: He stands in a snowy garden in his mustard-yellow raincoat holding one end of a long striped scarf. Beside him a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses wraps the other end of the scarf around the neck of a round snowman. Full body. Bright snow light.

shots.prompt: {moss} steps back and admires a round snowman in a striped scarf, hands on his hips, nodding. The camera dolly zooms. Bright snow light.
A snowball flies in and bursts on {moss}'s chest in a puff of snow, and he staggers back in surprise. The camera crash zooms in. Bright snow light.
shots.frame: He stands in a snowy garden beside a round snowman in a striped scarf, looking off to one side in surprise. Full body. Bright snow light.

shots.prompt: A baker in a white apron and a tall white hat peeks over a snowy garden fence, laughing, another snowball in his hand. The camera whip-pans to him. Bright snow light.
{moss} winds up and hurls a snowball with all his might, then falls forward into the snow. The camera tracks with the snowball. Bright snow light.
shots.frame: He stands in a snowy garden leaning back with one arm wound up behind him, a snowball in his hand and a mischievous grin, seen from the side. Full body. Bright snow light.

shots.prompt: A snowball knocks the tall white hat off a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat, who roars with laughter. The camera crash zooms in. Bright snow light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, laughing and dusted with snow, a round snowman in a striped scarf behind him. The camera orbits around him. Bright snow light.
{moss} and a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses lie on their backs in the snow making snow angels. Top-down, the camera spins slowly above them. Bright snow light.

{moss} rolls a snowball down a street of crooked clay houses deep in snow, past a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat and a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses who are each building a snowman. The camera tracks backward fast in front of him. Bright snow light. Warm windows.
A row of five snowmen of different sizes in scarves and hats lines a snowy street. The camera tracks along them. Golden afternoon snow light.
{moss} stamps the snow off his green boots on a doormat and steps into a warm kitchen where a kettle steams. The camera tracks in behind him through the door. Warm kitchen light.
Two clay hands wrap around a steaming mug of tea on a wooden table beside a pair of wet green mittens. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} sits by a window with a mug of tea, watching his snowman in the blue dusk outside as the snow keeps falling. The camera pulls back slowly through the window. Warm lamp glow, blue dusk.

A round snowman in a striped scarf stands in a garden at dusk under gently falling snow, warm windows glowing behind him. The camera cranes slowly up into the snowy sky. Warm window glow, soft blue dusk.

caption: first snow. moss nearly filmed it for the feed, then left his phone in the Hibernator and built a snowman instead
